title: Multiplication row sum
statement: For a Boolean $t$, a Boolean list $b$, and natural numbers $j,k$, define the row sum as the sum over $q$ from $0$ to $|b|-1$ of $t b_q$ when $k+q=j$, and $0$ otherwise; list entries beyond the list's length are interpreted as false, and Booleans as $0$ or $1$.
